description.partOne: is an interactive Pokémon catalog created as part of a team course project
description.partThree: The project combines a modern interface, convenient navigation, and collection elements, allowing users to explore the Pokémon world in a more lively and interactive format.

feature.six: Smooth UI animations and interactive elements

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.value: The primary framework used was Angular v21 with a standalone architecture and a modern approach to application development. For state management, NgRx (@ngrx/store) was used, enabling centralized data storage and simplifying application state handling. The user interface was implemented using Taiga UI v5, which accelerated development and ensured a consistent component design. The main programming language was TypeScript ~5.9, with strict typing enabled. RxJS was used for a reactive approach to data and event handling.

testing.title: Testing
testing.value: Vitest was used for testing. It was applied to verify component logic, services, and individual utility functions.

codeQuality.title: Code Quality
codeQuality.value: ESLint, Prettier, and Stylelint were used to maintain code quality. ESLint helped detect potential errors and enforce a consistent TypeScript code style, Prettier handled automatic code formatting, and Stylelint was used for SCSS/CSS validation.

gitWorkflow.title: Git Workflow
gitWorkflow.value: The project used Husky, commitlint, and lint-staged to automate the Git workflow. Husky ran git hooks before commits, commitlint ensured compliance with Conventional Commits, and lint-staged allowed running checks only on modified files.

rules.title: Rules
rules.value: The team followed the Conventional Commits standard for consistent commit history formatting. Branch naming validation and automated pre-commit checks were also configured, helping maintain project stability and quality.
